first_business_failure.message: Unexpected business text for resource: r14.chat.composer expected:<[]> but was:<[R14候选发送-1785363804188]>

root_cause: R14ChatDetailScreen text send used a trailing lambda. Because onFailure is the final function parameter of send(), Kotlin bound that lambda to onFailure instead of onSuccess, so a successful HTTP send never cleared composer.
required_fix: Use an explicitly named onSuccess callback, clear composer only on success, preserve the draft on failure, and retain the strict candidate empty-composer assertion.
